name: Xin Zhao
title: the Seneschal of Demacia

Q.name: Three Talon Strike
Q.description: Xin Zhao's next 3 Attacks deal an additional 15/30/45/60/75 + 0.45×bonus AD physical damage and reduces his other Ability's Cooldowns by 1 second. The third Attack also Knocks Up for 0.75 seconds.
Q.summary: Xin Zhao's next 3 standard attacks deal increased damage with the third attack knocking an opponent into the air.

W.name: Wind Becomes Lightning
W.description: Xin Zhao slashes, dealing 30/40/50/60/70 + 0.3×AD physical damage, then thrusts, dealing (50/85/120/155/190 + 0.9×AD + 0.65×AP) × (1 + 0.333×crit). Enemies hit by the thrust are Slowed by (varies)% for 1.5 + 0.005×AP seconds. Champions and Large Monsters hit by the thrust are marked as Challenged for 3 seconds and revealed unless Stealthed.
W.summary: Xin Zhao slashes in front of himself with his spear, then thrusts it forward, slowing affected enemies and marking them as Challenged.

E.name: Audacious Charge
E.description: Xin Zhao charges an enemy, dealing 50/75/100/125/150 + 1.2×AP magic damage to nearby enemies and Slowing them by 30% for 0.5 seconds. Xin Zhao grants himself (varies)% (%i:scaleAS%%i:scaleAP%) Attack Speed for 5 seconds. This Ability's range is increased on enemies that are Challenged.
E.summary: Xin Zhao charges to an enemy, gaining increased Attack Speed and dealing damage to all enemies in the area, slowing them briefly. This Ability gains increased range against Challenged targets.

R.name: Crescent Guard
R.description: Passive: The last champion Xin Zhao damaged with an Attack or Audacious Charge is Challenged for 3 seconds. Active: Xin Zhao unleashes a sweep around him that deals 75/175/275 + 1×bonus AD + 1.1×AP plus 15% current Health physical damage and Knocks Back all non-Challenged enemies. Afterwards, Xin Zhao becomes immune to damage from enemies outside the sweep range for 4 seconds.
R.summary: Xin Zhao passively challenges an enemy he damaged recently. When activated, Xin Zhao deals damage to nearby enemies based on their current Health and knocks non-challenged targets back, becoming impervious to damage dealt by champions outside of the circle created.

Passive.name: Determination
Passive.description: Every third attack deals bonus damage and heals Xin Zhao.
Passive.summary: Every third attack deals bonus damage and heals Xin Zhao.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Xin Zhao is a diving fighter jungler who charges in with Audacious Charge and knocks up with Three Talon Strike. He wins early skirmishes and protects himself in fights with Crescent Guard.
strengths: Very strong early ganks: E charge, then Q's third hit knocks up.
Strong duelist early, with healing on every third attack from Determination.
Crescent Guard deals % current HP damage, knocks back everyone except the challenged target, and blocks damage from outside the sweep.
Wind Becomes Lightning slows and marks targets so his E has more range.
Q lowers his other cooldowns, so he can use abilities often.
weaknesses: Melee and short range: kiting and slows stop him.
Falls off late against tanky teams and long-range damage.
Audacious Charge is his only dash; once used he has no escape.
Weak when behind: he needs early kills to stay relevant.
Crescent Guard's damage block only works for enemies outside the circle; melee champions inside can still hit him.

curve.lvl1: strong – Q and auto attacks win most level-1 jungle fights
curve.lvl2: strong – E charge into Q is a strong gank
curve.lvl3: very strong – full combo for strong early ganks and duels
curve.lvl6: strong – Crescent Guard gives a teamfight tool and protection
curve.items: medium – first item: Trinity Force or Sundered Sky for damage; Sterak's Gage or Death's Dance for survival
curve.late: okay – falls off against kiting and tanks late

profile.curveNote: Xin Zhao is strong from level 1 and wants to fight early. His power falls off as the game goes on, so he must use his early lead.
profile.waveClear: Good: Q and W clear camps and waves.
profile.sustain: Okay: passive heal on every third attack.
profile.mobility: Good: E charge, longer on challenged targets.

keyAbilities.trading: E (Audacious Charge) into Q (Three Talon Strike)
keyAbilities.engage: W (Wind Becomes Lightning) to slow and challenge
keyAbilities.escape: R (Crescent Guard) to protect himself and knock back others
keyAbilities.answers: Crescent Guard blocks damage from enemies outside its range.

Passive.notes: Determination: every third attack deals bonus damage and heals him.

Q.answer: Jax E dodges; Fiora W parries.
Q.notes: Three Talon Strike: his next three attacks deal bonus damage; the third knocks up.

W.notes: Wind Becomes Lightning: a slash then a thrust that slows, reveals and challenges, extending E's range.

E.notes: Audacious Charge: a point-and-click dash that slows briefly and gives him attack speed.

R.answer: Stay outside the circle when he uses it, and kill him once it ends.
R.notes: Crescent Guard: a sweep dealing % current HP damage and knocking back everyone except the challenged target; afterwards he takes no damage from enemies outside the sweep range for a few seconds.

profile.windowAgainst: Xin Zhao's window is after he has used Audacious Charge, or late in the game: kite him, and stay inside his Crescent Guard area so your damage still lands.
